name: Zansho Omimai Moushiagemasu. ~Kimi to Sugoshita Ano Hi to Ima to~
original_name: 残暑お見舞い申し上げます。～君と過ごしたあの日と今と～
source:
The main character is a university student, living in the country. One day, he hears that the area around his university will disappear under the reservoir of storage dam. He thought his peaceful life would last forever, but he now knows how valuable to live peacefully... He and his friends decide to make a movie as a memory of their university life.

Precious time with friends... Love and romance with heroines... Why don't you look for something important inside of you? 

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
主人公是一名生活在乡间的大学生。一天，他听说大学周边地区将被蓄水水坝的水库淹没。他原以为平静生活会永远持续，如今才明白安稳度日何其珍贵……他与朋友们决定拍摄一部电影，纪念自己的大学生活。

与朋友共度的珍贵时光……与女主角们经历的爱情……何不试着寻找自己内心真正重要的东西？

[摘自Himeya Shop]
